_about: Baselines of the nightly model evaluation (scripts/eval/nightly.ts, docs/TESTING.md TS-19 and TS-20), per platform as process.platform-process.arch. A gated number worse than its baseline, or with none, fails the night. Lower a baseline when a change makes a number better; raising one needs the reason in the commit. Rounded to two decimals.

_measured.linux-x64: the GitHub ubuntu-latest runner, the nights of 2026-10-01 and 2026-10-02, the same numbers both nights. English WER rose from 6.78 to 6.9 against the 2026-09-25 container baseline because that one was decoded with beam search (modified_beam_search) and the night decodes with the app default, greedy since #34; Spanish fell from 3.22 to 3.17 for the same reason; the AMI diarization error is unchanged
_measured.darwin-arm64: the GitHub macos-latest runner, the nights of 2026-10-01 and 2026-10-02, the same numbers both nights, greedy decoding
_measured.win32-x64: the GitHub windows-latest runner, the nights of 2026-10-01 and 2026-10-02, the same numbers both nights, greedy decoding
